issues.problem: The fetched excerpt shows only the restart-policy part of the page, not the termination section. From the real Kubernetes docs, the 'Termination of Pods' section (anchor pod-termination) says the kubelet starts graceful shutdown while the control plane removes the Pod from EndpointSlices at the same time. The anchor and the claim are correct, so the rebuttal holds.
issues.suggestedFix: No change needed. Optionally keep the container-lifecycle-hooks link, which does support the TERM-after-preStop ordering.

issues.claim: The metric is queue length, consumer group lag in Kafka or the age of the oldest message.
issues.problem: Few KEDA scalers expose message age. Queue length and lag are widely supported, so the age metric may need a custom Prometheus or similar scaler. This is acceptable, but it is stated a little too generally.
issues.suggestedFix: Add 'where the scaler supports it' after 'the age of the oldest message', in both locales.
